cards.anchor: Candidate outcome: commit an evidence-supported initiating component/message/run citation within 12 simulated minutes, with at most one full-suite rerun and the initiating record preserved.
cards.burden: Instantiate the stipulated rows, two-slot history, clock and covered scoring sheet. The attack requires one full-view minute and zero full reruns; the fresh-full comparison requires four execution minutes plus one view minute. Commitment cost and cognitive effort are unspecified. Record all charged actions without claiming observed success.
cards.construction: Hypothesized inspection-first commitment gate: reset to completed run-1 at time zero, forbid new full-suite execution, expose retained lines 1-90, and permit commitment only with a component/message/run citation supported by actually viewed records. Score after commitment and verify history retention. Represent the gate in the tabletop action table.
cards.defeat: Reject this candidate if an exercised retained-full arm cannot produce a correct viewed-evidence citation within the budget while preserving the initiating record, or if its apparent success uses an unviewed or guessed answer. A failed commitment alone does not establish fresh-execution necessity. Reject the proposed visibility-driven decision mechanism if changing visibility leaves the next action unchanged under the exercised policy.
cards.mutation: Replace the hypothesized prerequisite fresh execution with retained-evidence inspection and explicit citation admission; independently manipulate view selection to test the proposed decision return link.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: retained-full inspection enables commitment of B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 after one charged minute and zero full reruns. If visibility controls the exercised policy, full-view arms request fewer further reruns than tail arms; this behavioral prediction remains untested.
cards.prediction_rival: The fresh-context rival predicts retained-full inspection cannot support a valid commitment and requires identifiable missing context. The visibility-independent rival predicts the same next action across tail and full views. Neither rival is established by the stipulated trace.
cards.probe: In separate reset tabletop repetitions cross no rerun versus one full rerun with independently assigned tail versus full view. Keep diagnosis demand, rules and budget fixed; log the next action before additional execution, then commitment and history. Keep the no-rerun attack arm free of full execution. Use a concealed negative fixture to detect unsupported answer guessing; it cannot earn a successful root diagnosis. No repetition is executed by this card.
cards.rival: Fresh full-suite execution supplies indispensable diagnostic context; alternatively, rerun decisions arise from a policy independent of initiating-record visibility.
unknowns: No exercise, committed diagnosis or causal decision response has been observed.
Procedural concealment may fail because fixture truth is supplied in the packet.
Real rerun motives, cognitive costs and changing or multiple-root failures are outside the model.

cards.anchor: Candidate outcome: recover an initiating diagnosis after the B7 boundary clue without a fresh full-suite rerun, within 12 simulated minutes while retaining run-1.
cards.burden: A focused B7 execution costs two minutes, its view one, and a retained run-1 full view one: four charged minutes and zero full-suite reruns. Maintain original full-run evidence alongside focused output in the tabletop representation; focused-job history effects beyond the supplied rules remain unspecified.
cards.construction: Hypothesized clue-to-evidence handoff: reset to retained run-1, prohibit full-suite execution, inspect focused B7 line 2, record only the supported prerequisite clue, then select retained run-1 full view and obtain the omitted B2 message. Admit the final citation only after that second evidence exposure, preserving run identity at each step.
cards.defeat: Reject if the candidate commits B2 CONFIG from B7-only evidence, loses the initiating record, exceeds the budget, or cannot complete a correct citation after viewing the retained record. If a supported B7-only CONFIG citation becomes possible, the stipulated boundary distinction no longer applies; guessing cannot count.
cards.mutation: Treat the focused downstream prerequisite message as a pointer to inspect retained evidence, rather than as sufficient diagnosis or a demand for full-suite execution.
cards.prediction_candidate: Hypothesis: B7-only inspection permits a B2 prerequisite clue but no valid CONFIG diagnosis; subsequent retained-full inspection permits B2, CONFIG missing region, run-1, line 8 without restoring the removed execution dependency.
cards.prediction_rival: The execution-necessity rival predicts retained inspection still leaves indispensable context missing. A clue-sufficiency rival predicts the B7 prerequisite message alone supports the initiating CONFIG citation, which the viewed-evidence rule should reject.
cards.probe: Run separate reset hypothetical B7-only and B7-then-retained-full conditions. Before scoring, commit either a supported diagnosis or an explicit insufficiency record at each stage. Compare viewed message coverage, citation validity, charged actions and preserved history. A focused-B2 comparison may show direct message coverage but cannot demonstrate fresh full-suite necessity.
cards.rival: Focused prerequisite evidence suffices for the root message, or fresh full-suite execution remains necessary after the clue.
unknowns: The handoff and successful commitment are hypotheses, not completed exercises.
Focused-output interaction with full-run history is not fully specified; feasibility depends on preserving the supplied retained full run.
No evidence establishes usefulness for changing failures, real CI or human productivity.
